description: This file contains the implementation of the Promise class for handling asynchronous operations in PHP, following the Promises/A+ specification. It defines the Promise class with methods for then-chaining, waiting, resolving, rejecting, and cancelling promises, along with internal handling for promise states and callbacks.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: Implements a Promise object for asynchronous programming, capable of handling fulfillment, rejection, cancellation, and chaining.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Promise with optional wait and cancel callbacks.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Adds fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise, returning a new chained promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Adds a rejection handler to the promise chain.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is resolved or rejected, optionally unwrapping the value or throwing an exception.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('PENDING', 'FULFILLED', or 'REJECTED').

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise if it is pending, invoking the cancel callback if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Fulfills the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.
